limitations.title: Trust Graph remains local-scope
limitations.summary: Trust Graph Local RC remains local advisory trust, not a global Web of Trust, routing policy, crawler, or legacy WoT compatibility layer.
limitations.boundedBy: Stable 1.0 may ship with local-scope Trust Graph wording as long as docs and release notes keep the non-goals explicit.

limitations.title: Social Inbox is not legacy Freetalk or Sone compatible
limitations.summary: Social Inbox RC remains a local threaded social/message reference app and does not provide Freetalk, Sone, Freemail, or daemon-core social protocol compatibility.
limitations.boundedBy: Stable 1.0 may ship with this limitation when migration docs keep the legacy-protocol boundary explicit.

limitations.title: Freemail-like migration remains future app or service work
limitations.summary: Freemail-like encrypted mail migration remains documented as future app or app-service work and is not a Stable 1.0 compatibility promise.
limitations.boundedBy: Stable 1.0 release notes must avoid presenting this as shipped mail compatibility.

limitations.title: Third-party app intake remains beta-limited
limitations.summary: Third-party app intake may remain beta-limited if at least one stable-target sample app passes submission, pre-review, review decision, beta catalog candidate, install smoke, rejection, caution, resubmission, compatibility, docs, and redaction evidence.
limitations.boundedBy: No third-party app may be promoted as stable without review receipt and compatibility evidence.

limitations.title: No rollback path
limitations.summary: Stable 1.0 cannot ship without app install/update/catalog rollback evidence.

limitations.title: No app-data backup or export for stable first-party apps
limitations.summary: Stable first-party apps with durable state must have backup, restore, migration, or an explicit not-applicable policy.

limitations.title: No security advisory or denylist response
limitations.summary: Stable 1.0 cannot ship without advisory, denylist, revocation, and fail-closed update evidence.

limitations.title: No Platform API stable compatibility window
limitations.summary: Stable 1.0 cannot ship without Platform API 1.0 baseline, previous snapshot, compatibility-window, and deprecation/removal policy evidence.

limitations.title: No support bundle redaction
limitations.summary: Stable 1.0 cannot ship without privacy-preserving diagnostics and support bundle redaction guidance.

limitations.title: No third-party submission path
limitations.summary: Stable 1.0 cannot ship with no third-party submission, review, rejection, resubmission, and beta-catalog sample path.
